events.comment:
================================================================================
SYSTEM: FLOWER SYSTEM (SPRINT 3.4.5 DECOUPLED TRANSACTION UPGRADE)
AUTHOR: Antigravity | LAST MODIFIED: 2026-07-16
PURPOSE: Quản lý sinh trưởng và phát tín hiệu giao dịch tách rời InventoryRemoveRequest,
FlowerHarvested, và MarkSaveDirty. Cấm sửa gold hoặc inventory trực tiếp!
================================================================================
BLOCK 1: INITIALIZATION & GRID GENERATION (At Beginning of GreenhouseScene)

actions.comment: Generate 20x20 GridSlots with base spacing 32px, interactable_type = Soil, and set initial state Empty

events.comment: BLOCK 2: ROUTED CONSUMER — PLANTING SEED (InteractSoil + Plant Mode)

actions.comment: Verify GridSlot state == Empty -> Emit EventBus.Emit("InventoryRemoveRequest", { item_id: payload.selected_item_id, quantity: 1 })
Spawn FlowerInstanceObject stage = 0 -> Set GridSlot state = Occupied -> Emit FlowerPlanted -> MarkSaveDirty

events.comment: BLOCK 3: ROUTED CONSUMER — WATERING SOIL & PLANT (InteractSoil + Water Mode)

actions.comment: Restore GridSlot and Flower moisture = 100 -> Play SFX WaterSplash -> MarkSaveDirty

events.comment: BLOCK 4: TIME-SLICED RUNTIME & DEBUG-ONLY TIME SKIP (TimeMinuteTicked / Key T)

actions.comment: If Key 'T' pressed and g_IsDebugMode == true -> Add +60 minutes instantly (DEBUG_BUILD_ONLY)
Advance stage: Stage 0 -> Stage 1 -> Stage 2 -> Stage 3 (Bloom). If stage == 3, emit FlowerBloomed and MarkSaveDirty!

events.comment: BLOCK 5: ROUTED CONSUMER — HARVESTING FLOWER (InteractFlower Hook)

actions.comment: Check target flower stage == 3 -> Destroy flower sprite -> Reset GridSlot to Empty -> Play SFX Chime -> MarkSaveDirty
Emit pure event: EventBus.Emit("FlowerHarvested", { flower_id: "flower_white_lily", yield: 1, gold_earned: 50, grid_x: slot.grid_x, grid_y: slot.grid_y })
